root_cause: Existing freshnessWeight capped negative age at zero: a future-dated result received the same full freshness factor as an actually observed present result. The business value ranker also classified finite out-of-range confidence as known evidence.
fix: Reject future timestamps and invalid or unparsable observation/reference time as unknown. Refuse confidence outside inclusive [0,1] as known. Preserve valid historical positive and negative observations.
prevention_rule: Before any agent ranks or promotes a business-value observation, validate the observation time is not in the future relative to a valid reference time, value is finite and confidence lies between 0 and 1. Unknown gets null priority and must not be treated as learned ROI or as independently verified customer outcome.

positive: valid historical observed benefit ranks with its confidence and freshness
genuinely observed negative value remains eligible to show loss
negative: future-dated fabricated high value becomes unknown

invariants: No future timestamp is counted as current observed business value
No invalid confidence is counted as known value
A measured loss remains a known negative value
No synthetic evaluations or fake champion are automatically promoted
No additional scheduler, persistent Brain store or direct database writes

next_safe_action: Require exact-head source tests, admission, Required and CodeQL, protected merge, immutable main and production readback; business lift and genuine tenant benefit remain unproven.
